svg.title: FlashAttention avoids full matrices in HBM
svg.desc: FlashAttention tiles attention blocks in on-chip SRAM and uses online softmax, avoiding storage of full n-by-n score and probability matrices in HBM. The output is exact and memory traffic drops, while FLOPs remain O(n²d).

g.text: FlashAttention avoids full matrices in HBM
Tiling keeps blocks in fast SRAM and updates softmax online; FLOPs stay quadratic.
Write/read S and P in HBM: large memory traffic.
Exact output · O(n) memory · fewer HBM accesses
